title: Item 15d · Where settings live
subtitle: Approved in each section. The things you set once — prices, rubrics, templates, statuses — live in 8 places: a tab in five sections (Color Belt, Star, Black Belt, Camps, Finance), the page's ⋯ menu in two (Prospects and Calendar — your v0.245: “like the Calendar's Event types”), and the school-wide Settings page (account menu → Admin), which holds only the schools' addresses and phones. One home doesn't fit: Classes and ranks are used by the Schedule, Calendar, Forms and Testing, but live inside Color Belt testing (v0.38). The Schedule and Forms say “Add classes in Testing → Classes and ranks” — once Star goes live that is Testing → Color belt testing → Classes and ranks. Your plan of 2026-10-17 (not decided yet): move them to a school-wide Settings once the Schedule and Calendar are built. They are now. (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

columns.note: The rule in B: things several sections use live in Settings (Schools, Classes and ranks). Things one section uses live in that section: a tab named for what's in it, next to the main tab (Star, Black Belt, Camps, Finance — as today), or the page's ⋯ menu where a page has no tabs (Prospects, Calendar — as today). This is your plan of 2026-10-17, with your leaning that testing prices stay in Testing. Pictures 10–11 are drawn over the real pages; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question: where should settings live?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − Classes and ranks stay inside Color belt testing although the Schedule, Calendar and Forms need them; no written rule, so the next section can invent a ninth place.
B · Recommended: one rule, and Classes and ranks move to Settings (pictures 10–11) — your own plan. + adding a class for the Schedule happens where the whole school's details are; one rule for every section; nothing else moves. − a medium job for Color Belt and Main (the class editor splits: classes and ranks in Settings, testing prices in Color Belt); Settings is admins only, so staff no longer see the ranks list (they still see testing prices in Color Belt and class names in the Schedule); Settings sits under your initials, where the Grandmaster may not look — the Schedule's and Forms' hints would link straight to it.
C · One Settings page for everything. Every section's settings move into Settings, one part each. + one place to look. − the biggest job (all six sessions); settings sit far from the work they change (a camp template is made from a camp); staff lose the view-only price tabs.
